def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # fix island case variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # numeric columns stored as text (commas, plain strings)
    for col in ['body_mass_g', 'flipper_length_mm']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
            errors='coerce'
        )
    # body_mass_g out of range: values far above 6500 g are assumed to be milligrams
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    grouped = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
